templates.name: homepage
templates.description: Locale landing page with full-width hero image, headline, and a grid of featured teasers linking into adventures and magazine content. Full variant (us/en, ca/en) has a hero carousel, featured-article teaser, recent-articles cards grid, adventure teaser, and adventures cards grid. Minor locales (ch/*, de/de, es/es, fr/fr, it/it, ca/fr, us/es) are 'coming soon' stubs with a single hero teaser (heading + image).

templates.name: adventure-detail
templates.description: Adventure detail page — full-bleed hero image, adventure title (H1), a structured fact sheet (Activity, Adventure Type, Trip Length, Group Size, Difficulty, Price) sourced from an AEM Content Fragment, a 'Share this Adventure' block, and long-form body copy authored in Tabs (Overview / Itinerary / What to Bring) flattened to headed default content.

templates.name: article-detail
templates.description: Magazine article detail page — a full-bleed lead hero image, article title (H1) + author byline (h4), long-form rich-text body (headings, paragraphs, native blockquote pull-quote, interleaved full-width inline images), an author-bio attribution row, and a text-only 'Up Next' related-reading list. Only the lead hero is a block (hero-banner); everything else is default content.

templates.name: section-landing
templates.description: Section landing page. Magazine index: title + featured-article teaser (columns-featured) + 'All Articles' article grid (cards-teaser) + 'Members Only' secure teaser grid (cards-teaser). About-us: title + intro + two contributor profile grids ('Our Contributors' 4-up, 'WKND Guides' 3-up) rendered as cards-profile. Section titles and intro text are default content.

templates.name: adventures-listing
templates.description: Adventures listing page — H1 title, a full-bleed hero teaser (heading + intro over background image), and a 'Current Adventures' grid of 16 adventure teaser cards. An AEM Tabs activity filter renders 6 sibling image-list grids; only the active/All panel (16 cards) is mapped to avoid duplication. Reuses hero-banner + cards-teaser; no new blocks.

templates.name: faq-page
templates.description: FAQ page — H1 'FAQs', an inline intro image + paragraph (default content), a 7-item expandable Q/A accordion (accordion-faq block), and a 'Need more help?' contact aside (default content).
